description: Starts an asynchronous export of one Test Run's test cases to an Excel workbook, optionally filtered with `query`, ordered with `sortBy`, and shaped by an export `template`. Returns a `jobs` resource, not the file: poll `getJob` until finished, then download the workbook with `getJobResultFileContent`. To import results back, use `importExcelTestResults`.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

query.description: Polarion Lucene-style query string to filter results: field:value clauses combined with AND/OR, phrases in quotes. Exact supported field names depend on the resource type being queried.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

sortBy.description: The property to sort the test results.

testRunId.description: The Test Run's ID within its project.

name: getExportExcelTests
